data.action: 白无垢十指相扣立神前，紫瞳认真含泪微笑
data.camera: wide shot, formal portrait, bride holding hands, shrine light, tender vow
data.description: 【神社·婚礼日】向来向死而行的虫柱，今天披上了纯白无垢。白角隐下的紫瞳认真得前所未有，她在神前与你十指相扣——「我这一生的剧毒，本该随我葬进夜里。……但如果是你，毒也会变成药。所以，请让我把余下的每一天，都用来对你温柔。」
data.promptProse: The Insect Hashira who walked toward death all her life wears pure white shiromuku today. Standing at the shrine altar with fingers interlaced with yours, Kochou Shinobu's purple eyes are more earnest than ever beneath the white tsunokakushi as she vows that the poison meant to be buried with her turns to medicine in your hands, and asks to spend every remaining day being gentle to you. Formal portrait, cinematic lighting, shrine light, detailed background.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 白无垢的花嫁之誓·「如果是你，毒也会变成药」
